entities.summary: Xavier Cooks is an Australian professional basketball player for the Sydney Kings of the National Basketball League (NBL). He is also contracted with Vaqueros de Bayamón of the Baloncesto Superior Nacional. He played college basketball for the Winthrop Eagles, where he was named the 2018 Big South Conference Player of the Year. In 2022, he helped the Sydney Kings win the NBL championship while earning grand final MVP honours. In 2023, he was named NBL MVP and won his second straight NBL championship.
